questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests practical data quality, idempotent sinks, and operational design using Dataflow + BigQuery features.

## Key Concepts

- Idempotent sink
- insertId dedup
- staging vs final table
- MERGE in BigQuery
- allowed lateness and partitioning
- quotas and monitoring

## Code Example

```sql
MERGE INTO dataset.final AS F
USING dataset.staging AS S
ON F.user_id = S.user_id AND F.event_time = S.event_time
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, event_time, event_id, action, payload)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET action = S.action, payload = S.payload;
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How to handle tombstones?
- How to scale MERGE with sharded partitions?
- How would you instrument observability for dedup latency?

```python
    yield (target_table, element)
```
